params.prompt: Minimal flat vector map illustration, square 1:1, on a plain very dark warm background (#0B0907). Silhouette of Great Britain in dark graphite grey (#1c1713) with a thin subtle warm grey outline, no other countries, no grid, centered, occupying most of the frame. One single glowing yellow (#FDD506) round pin dot placed in the north of England where Leeds is, with a soft yellow glow and a thin yellow ring around it. Clean, modern, minimal infographic style, generous empty space. No text, no letters, no labels, no logos, no watermark.
